versions.short: The bill would require the Small Business Administration to create and maintain a webpage within 60 days of enactment that lists resources and information for small businesses on moving some or all of their manufacturing back to the United States. The webpage would include general contact information, a free tool to help small businesses find entities that could assist with such onshoring, and other information the agency considers appropriate. The agency would seek yearly input from its advocacy office on improving the page for four years, submit a report to Congress on the page's effectiveness within two years and yearly updates until four years after enactment, and the requirements would end four years after enactment.
